text: Despite its limitations, skinfold measurement generally provides valid assessments of fat-free mass at a single time point. Its predictive capacity in bodybuilders was found to be highly correlated with the 4C model ( r = .93) (89). Lean mass estimates by skinfold also showed high agreement with hydrodensitometry ( r = .94) in a cohort of NCAA Division I football players (70).
